text:
harper: Quick thread to nail down Q3 decisions for dedicated: 1) default spill behavior, 2) burst-envelope UX, 3) autoscale damping & escape hatch, 4) billing visibility for carryover. Need product signoff by EOD Fri.

diego: Ops constraints: don’t let shared pools get stomped. Default should allow spill to shared for self-serve, but enterprise contracts can opt-out. Need a measurable guardrail metric.

sylvie: Sales input: top pilot customers want a clear envelope + "escape hatch" that forces failover to shared when latency hits X. They also want to see future carryover as an addon.

harper: Proposed defaults: spill_to_shared = true (self-serve), spill_to_shared = false (enterprise opt-out), carryover = false by default (paid opt-in). Autoscale hysteresis = 6m, min_scale_interval = 12m.

diego: Add runtime guard: metric shared_pool_spill_rate pct over 0.5% sustained 5m -> auto-prioritize capacity and page oncall. Also make a tenant_spill_alert when a single tenant causes >60% of spills.

sylvie: UI: Console card shows "Burst envelope: 50k tokens / 5m (usage 28k) | Carryover: off". Add an 80% threshold alert and a historical envelope heatmap. Pilot only needs the card + alert.

harper: Billing schema (minimal) must emit events: burst.grant, burst.consume, carryover.apply, spill.to_shared. Billing-bot, can you stub those?

billing-bot: stubbed: burst.grant, burst.consume, carryover.apply, decay.apply, spill.to_shared. Link: https://internal.redwood/billing/events#reserve (internal).

diego: Autoscale policy: scale-up if occupancy > 75% for 10m, scale-down if < 45% for 15m. Rate-limit changes to 1 per 12m. Add warmup window to avoid preempting running requests.

harper: Escape hatch idea: tenant-level "emergency_spillback" toggle that sales can enable for pilots. When enabled it temporarily widens spill heuristics and reduces isolation guarantees. Requires explicit note in contract.

sylvie: Sales OK but legal must approve language. We'll package escape hatch as a signed checkbox in the contract. Carryover as paid addon.

diego: Runbook: draft playbook entries for: high shared_pool_spill_rate, tenant runaway, and manual emergency_spillback toggle. I’ll draft and post in eng-oncall.

harper: Pilot scope (must-have): deterministic spill ordering (priority -> age), envelope Console card + 80% alert, billing event stubs, autoscale hysteresis and runbook. Nice-to-have: prewarm vesting, carryover UX, contractual SLA verbiage.

sylvie: Owners: harper (product), diego (infra + runbook), sylvie (GTM + contracts), billing-bot (billing events). Timeline: feature-flagged pilot in 4w.

harper: Ok locking this in. Follow-up doc in /docs and demo to sales next Tue. If no objections by EOD Fri we close. :thumbsup:
